QuestInfo.name: The One Who's Touched the Sky
QuestInfo.0: Let's aim for the top! Something good will happen if you visit the high-altitude locations around Maple World.
QuestInfo.1: #b#eTitle - The One Who's Touched the Sky#n#k\r\nLet's climb to the top of high-altitude locations in Maple World.\r\n#bReach #R27018# from a total of 5 regions.#k
QuestInfo.2: You're #b<The One Who's Touched the Sky>#k. You were able to breathe fresh air at the top of the world while looking down at beautiful, calming views.

1.0: Can you confidently call yourself a person who's been at the top? Haha

yes.0: How does it feel to be at the top? Don't forget that feeling, and try to be at the top in whatever you do.

quest.0: You have much more to climb.
